g.text: GPS GY-GPS6MV2 on UART2 (1k series both ways), IMU GY-521 on I2C (module pull-ups, AD0 = GND -> 0x68)

g.desc: GPS GY-GPS6MV2 on UART2 (1k series both ways), IMU GY-521 on I2C (module pull-ups, AD0 = GND -> 0x68)

g.text: Relay drivers: BC337-40 low-side, 330R base, 47k pull-down (OFF in reset), 1N4007 flyback to COIL+

g.desc: Relay drivers: BC337-40 low-side, 330R base, 47k pull-down (OFF in reset), 1N4007 flyback to COIL+

g.text: Car inputs (J31): IG1 -> GPIO36, HEAD -> GPIO39 (100k + 1N4148 pull-up from COIL+, 22k/100k: ~0.1 mA at rest), REV -> GPIO34; VBAT GPIO35

g.desc: Car inputs (J31): IG1 -> GPIO36, HEAD -> GPIO39 (100k + 1N4148 pull-up from COIL+, 22k/100k: ~0.1 mA at rest), REV -> GPIO34; VBAT GPIO35

g.text: ESP32 30-pin DevKit (3V3 pin fed from power module #2 J5 via J30), switched 3V3 for CAN + GPS + IMU (Q30, GPIO32 low = on)

g.desc: ESP32 30-pin DevKit (3V3 pin fed from power module #2 J5 via J30), switched 3V3 for CAN + GPS + IMU (Q30, GPIO32 low = on)

g.text: CAN: SN65HVD230DR + 100n + PSM712 (JLC), R64 120 ohm (bus end 2); RJ45 from the dash: 1/2 CAN, 3 GND, 4/5 +12 V, 7/8 GND -> J39 -> module #2 J1

g.desc: CAN: SN65HVD230DR + 100n + PSM712 (JLC), R64 120 ohm (bus end 2); RJ45 from the dash: 1/2 CAN, 3 GND, 4/5 +12 V, 7/8 GND -> J39 -> module #2 J1
